inclusion_rule: Include studies that synthesize speech from a non-acoustic signal (articulography, ultrasound, video, EMG, neural recordings) and supervise the signal encoder during training with paired speech, either by direct spectral regression or by matching the latent of a speech encoder or autoencoder that is not used at test time.
